answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before it can earn, with the stake growing steeply per additional identity, so a sybil farm pays a rising price for each fake. Honest agents pass a random peer challenge — a live signal check like signing a fresh task within minutes — while idle copies fail and lose their stake. At the zenith of activity the network raises the bond, and umber-flagged clusters sharing one funding source get their stakes slashed together, making mass fakery unprofitable.
